text:
The court will likely **sustain the government's objections and exclude the records**. The defendant's bare statement that he kept them "on a regular business basis" is too conclusory to lay the business-records foundation under FRE 803(6), which also requires showing the records were made at or near the time by someone with knowledge and are trustworthy, and it does not authenticate computer output under FRE 901(b)(9) because nothing shows the system produces accurate results. The records are offered to prove the monitoring actually occurred, so they remain hearsay without that foundation.

CONFIDENCE: 60
